methodology: Illustrative index compounds column H price returns in closing-time order. Only executed, completed simulator trades are included. Overlapping positions, leverage, capital allocation, exchange costs and CryptoLove fees are not reproduced by this index. This is historical simulation, not live performance.

provenance.timezoneBasis: Source code exports host-local dates without timezone. All available opening times were checked against explicit UTC labels in column Q. Closing UTC is inferred using the matching local timezone.
provenance.closingPrecision: minutes in supplied workbook; seconds padded with zero
provenance.capitalReturnColumn: O: net simulated PnL / allocated capital, including source leverage and source estimated costs
provenance.accountBalanceColumn: P: source simulator account balance, not the normalized index
